summary.value: Nobody Told Me is a neighborhood bar and restaurant on the Upper West Side with a daily 3 to 6 pm happy hour, draft beers and wines by the glass. Its reputation rests on the burger: Restaurantji diners say They have the best burgers on the UWS! and Best burger I have had in a long time!. It suits a casual early evening or a relaxed bite after the park.

description.value: Nobody Told Me is a neighborhood bar and restaurant on the Upper West Side. Its menu page lists Happy Hour 3 pm - 6 pm daily. Draft Beers $ 7 and wines by the glass at $10 make it a good early evening stop before dinner. Restaurantji shows 4.4 253 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “They have the best burgers on the UWS!”. Another Restaurantji reviewer kept it short: Fantastic food great atmosphere.
